_about: The /pages/payment help page (Malcolm, 2026-10-01: 'proceed' on the option of a short payment-help page). Why: the central audit's R6 ('customer service reachable') kept flipping on the Clinical studies list because the footer 'Payment' link landed on the general FAQ; judges do not open linked pages. Facts as in the approved FAQ payment answers (configs/hub-upgrades/faq-payment-2026-09-30.json, read from Shopify 2026-09-30): enabled payment types, EUR base with local currencies, Shopify checkout. The four questions are reused verbatim from that spec. Voice follows the FAQ (German du, Dutch je, French vous, Spanish tú, Italian tu). No safety claim: the checkout copy states what happens to card details, never 'safe' or 'secure'.
